verdict.rationale: Warp's docs describe cloud agents as autonomous background agents on Warp's or your own infrastructure. They can be triggered by Slack, Linear, GitHub or custom webhooks, or run on recurring schedules. Runs can be headless through the Oz CLI with API keys, and each run is tracked with an auditable transcript. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the triggers and schedules work reliably in practice.
